title: Helmet Detection AI
description: Real-time Helmet Detection system using Deep Learning and YOLOv8. Detects helmets on people in images, videos, and live camera feeds — making workplaces and safety monitoring smarter and automated.

details.problem: Industrial workplaces face severe safety hazards when workers fail to wear protective helmets. Manual monitoring is inefficient, prone to human error, and impossible to scale across large construction or manufacturing sites.
details.whyIUsedThis: I chose YOLOv8 for its state-of-the-art real-time object detection capabilities. Unlike older architectures like Faster R-CNN, YOLO provides the perfect balance between high accuracy and real-time inference speed, which is critical for live camera feeds. Python and Jupyter Notebooks were used for rapid prototyping, data augmentation, and model training due to their massive ecosystem of computer vision libraries (OpenCV, PyTorch).
features: Real-time video and image processing capabilities
High accuracy detection even in crowded environments
Custom trained YOLOv8 weights optimized for hard hats
Seamless integration with live CCTV camera feeds
Automated alert triggering for safety violations

title: NGAI Cricket Vision
description: Next-generation AI cricket analysis system combining computer vision techniques for real-time ball tracking, batsman pose estimation, and LBW decision support.

details.problem: Professional cricket analysis systems (like Hawk-Eye) are incredibly expensive and require specialized multi-camera setups. Amateur and semi-pro teams lack access to advanced analytics like ball tracking and LBW predictions.
details.whyIUsedThis: I used a custom computer vision pipeline leveraging deep learning to track the high-speed motion of a cricket ball from standard video feeds. TypeScript was used to build the front-end interface, ensuring a robust, type-safe, and highly interactive dashboard where coaches can analyze the trajectory data in real-time.
features: Predictive ball trajectory mapping and 3D visualization
Automated LBW (Leg Before Wicket) decision support algorithms
Pitch map generation and bowler speed estimation
Interactive coach dashboard built with TypeScript
Cost-effective solution running on standard 60fps camera footage

title: Batsman Pose Detection
description: AI-powered batsman pose detection and analysis using Google MediaPipe. Tracks 33 body landmarks in real-time for cricket stance evaluation and biomechanical analysis.

details.problem: Cricket batsmen struggle to self-correct their stances and biomechanical flaws without a professional coach. Traditional video analysis requires manual frame-by-frame review, which is tedious and lacks quantitative metrics.
details.whyIUsedThis: Google MediaPipe was the perfect choice because it provides blazingly fast, out-of-the-box pose estimation tracking 33 3D landmarks without requiring heavy GPU compute. Python facilitated the rapid calculation of joint angles and biomechanical metrics, allowing me to build algorithms that detect flaws like incorrect backlift or poor foot movement.
features: Real-time tracking of 33 key body landmarks
Automated calculation of joint angles (elbow, knee, shoulder)
Visual feedback overlays for stance correction
High-performance inference suitable for consumer-grade devices
Data export for detailed post-session biomechanical analysis

title: Fabric Detection + Flutter App
description: End-to-end fabric defect detection system powered by AI, paired with a cross-platform Flutter mobile app for on-site quality control and real-time classification.

details.problem: Quality control in textile manufacturing is traditionally a manual, labor-intensive process. Human inspectors get fatigued, leading to missed defects, production delays, and material waste.
details.whyIUsedThis: I built a deep learning model to accurately classify microscopic fabric defects. For the user interface, I chose Flutter. Flutter allowed me to compile a beautiful, native-feeling app for both iOS and Android from a single codebase. It provides the seamless integration needed to run AI inferences on the edge using the smartphone's camera.
features: Cross-platform mobile application built with Flutter
On-device AI inference for detecting holes, stains, and thread errors
Real-time defect highlighting using the smartphone camera
Cloud synchronization for quality assurance managers
Detailed reporting and analytics dashboard

title: Voice Sentiment Analysis
description: AI system that analyzes voice recordings to detect emotional sentiment and tone. Combines audio signal processing with NLP models to classify speech as positive, negative, or neutral.

details.problem: Text-based sentiment analysis misses a crucial element of human communication: tone of voice. Customer service centers need a way to detect customer frustration or satisfaction directly from audio calls.
details.whyIUsedThis: I utilized Python's rich audio processing ecosystem (like Librosa) to extract Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) and pitch variations. These features were then fed into a Deep Learning NLP/Audio model. Jupyter Notebooks were essential here for visualizing audio waveforms and iteratively tuning the neural network architecture.
features: Extraction of complex audio features (MFCCs, Chroma, Mel Spectrograms)
Classification of emotions (Angry, Happy, Neutral, Sad)
Handling of background noise and varying speech rates
Real-time processing pipeline for live audio streams
Integration APIs for customer support platforms

title: PipMaster Pro
description: Professional forex trading pip calculator and risk management app built with Flutter. Features real-time P&L calculations, risk manager, trade history with PDF export, and a premium dark UI.

details.problem: Forex traders often struggle with rapid risk calculation. Calculating pip values, lot sizes, and potential profit/loss across different currency pairs under pressure leads to poor risk management and blown accounts.
details.whyIUsedThis: Flutter and Dart were the perfect combination for this FinTech app. Flutter's UI engine allowed me to create a highly responsive, premium dark-mode interface with smooth animations that traders love. Dart's strong typing ensures precision in financial calculations where floating-point errors are unacceptable.
features: Real-time pip value calculator for major, minor, and exotic pairs
Advanced risk management tool (Lot size calculation based on account equity)
Trade history logging and performance analytics
One-click professional PDF report generation
Stunning, buttery-smooth custom UI tailored for traders

title: AI Emergency Trigger
description: An emergency trigger system powered by AI to automatically alert and respond in critical situations.

details.problem: In critical emergencies, every second counts. Traditional alarm systems require manual activation, which is often impossible if the victim is incapacitated or under immediate threat.
details.whyIUsedThis: I utilized advanced AI anomaly detection algorithms to monitor environmental signals (sound, motion, and visual cues). By processing these inputs locally, the system can instantly trigger alerts without relying on a human intermediary. This ensures zero latency in dispatching SOS signals.
features: Automated anomaly detection utilizing multi-modal AI
Zero-latency localized processing for immediate response
Integration with emergency broadcasting APIs
Failsafe mechanisms to prevent false positives
24/7 autonomous monitoring system

title: Sketch to 3D Model
description: An AI tool that transforms 2D sketches into 3D models using Python and deep learning.

details.problem: 3D modeling is an incredibly steep learning curve. Designers and game developers spend hours converting conceptual 2D sketches into structural 3D meshes using complex software like Blender or Maya.
details.whyIUsedThis: I leveraged Python alongside state-of-the-art Generative AI and Computer Vision frameworks. Python's integration with PyTorch allowed me to implement diffusion models capable of inferring depth and geometry from flat, hand-drawn lines, bridging the gap between 2D art and 3D assets seamlessly.
features: Instant conversion of hand-drawn sketches to 3D meshes (.obj, .stl)
Deep learning-based depth inference and texture generation
Support for rough, unrefined concept art
Export capabilities directly into game engines (Unity/Unreal)
Automated UV mapping and basic shading

title: Rambows Hands
description: Hand tracking and gesture recognition project built with Python.

details.problem: Traditional human-computer interaction relies heavily on keyboards and mice. In AR/VR, robotics, and accessibility, there is a massive need for intuitive, touchless gesture control systems that understand intricate hand movements.
details.whyIUsedThis: I built this using Python because of its unparalleled speed in prototyping computer vision pipelines. By integrating lightweight pose estimation models, I achieved high-FPS hand tracking on standard CPUs. This architecture ensures the project is highly accessible without needing expensive graphic cards.
features: High-FPS real-time hand landmark tracking
Custom gesture recognition engine (pinch, swipe, grab)
Touchless UI navigation capabilities
Multi-hand detection support
Low-latency processing optimized for standard webcams

title: Cineverse
description: A cinematic universe web application built using HTML and modern web technologies.

details.problem: Movie databases and streaming platforms often suffer from cluttered, overly complex user interfaces. Users want an immersive, visually striking platform to discover and explore cinematic content.
details.whyIUsedThis: I focused on fundamental web technologies (HTML, CSS) combined with modern UI/UX principles to ensure maximum performance and accessibility. By avoiding heavy framework overhead for the core structure, the site delivers a blazing-fast, cinematic browsing experience with stunning micro-animations.
features: Highly responsive, mobile-first cinematic grid layout
Smooth page transitions and hover micro-animations
Dynamic filtering and search capabilities
Integration with movie database APIs for live data
Premium dark-mode aesthetics
